chapters.text_fil: Ang lalawigan ng Sultan Kudarat ay pinangalanan bilang parangal sa Sultan Muhammad Dipatuan Kudarat ang pinaka-bantog na sultan ng Maguindanao na namuhay noong ika-labimpito at ika-labing-walong siglo. Siya ay kilala sa kanyang matapang na pagtutol sa mga mananakop na Kastila at sa kanyang kahusayan bilang isang pinuno at mandirigma.
chapters.text_eng: The province of Sultan Kudarat was named in honor of Sultan Muhammad Dipatuan Kudarat the most renowned sultan of Maguindanao who lived during the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries. He is known for his courageous resistance against the Spanish colonizers and his excellence as a leader and warrior.
